tape.en: She used tape to attach the notice to the wall.
tape.zh: 她用膠帶把公告貼在牆上。

taste.en: The soup has a mild taste that most students enjoy.
taste.zh: 這碗湯味道清淡，多數學生都喜歡。

tasty.en: The cafeteria served a tasty vegetable dish for lunch.
tasty.zh: 學校餐廳午餐供應一道美味的蔬菜料理。

tax.en: The lesson explains how tax revenue supports public services.
tax.zh: 課堂說明稅收如何支持公共服務。

taxi.en: They took a taxi from the station to the hotel.
taxi.zh: 他們從車站搭計程車前往飯店。

taxicab.en: An old taxicab appears in the historical photograph.
taxicab.zh: 一輛老式計程車出現在歷史照片中。

tea.en: She drank warm tea while reviewing her notes.
tea.zh: 她一邊複習筆記一邊喝溫茶。

teapot.en: A ceramic teapot sat in the center of the table.
teapot.zh: 桌子中央放著一只陶瓷茶壺。

tear.en: Be careful not to tear the map while unfolding it.
tear.zh: 展開地圖時小心不要撕破。

tease.en: Classmates should not tease someone for making a mistake.
tease.zh: 同學不應因別人犯錯而取笑對方。

technical.en: The manual provides technical details about the new equipment.
technical.zh: 手冊提供新設備的技術細節。

technician.en: A technician checked the projector before the presentation began.
technician.zh: 簡報開始前，技術人員檢查了投影機。

technological.en: Technological change has transformed how students access information.
technological.zh: 科技變化已改變學生取得資訊的方式。

tedious.en: Entering hundreds of records by hand was a tedious task.
tedious.zh: 手動輸入數百筆資料是一項繁瑣工作。

teenage.en: The novel follows a teenage student adjusting to a new school.
teenage.zh: 這本小說描寫一名青少年學生適應新學校。

teenager.en: Every teenager in the program receives a study guide.
teenager.zh: 計畫中的每位青少年都會拿到一份學習指南。

teens.en: The survey asks teens about their preferred study habits.
teens.zh: 這份調查詢問青少年偏好的讀書習慣。

telecommunications.en: Modern telecommunications allow information to travel around the world quickly.
telecommunications.zh: 現代電信技術讓資訊能快速傳遍世界。

telegraph.en: The museum displays an early telegraph used for long-distance messages.
telegraph.zh: 博物館展示一部早期用於遠距傳訊的電報機。

telescope.en: The astronomy club used a telescope to observe the moon.
telescope.zh: 天文社用望遠鏡觀察月球。

teller.en: The bank teller explained the form to the customer.
teller.zh: 銀行櫃員向顧客說明這份表格。

temper.en: He learned to control his temper during stressful situations.
temper.zh: 他學會在壓力情境中控制脾氣。

temple.en: The old temple attracts visitors interested in local history.
temple.zh: 這座古老寺廟吸引對地方歷史有興趣的訪客。

tempo.en: The conductor increased the tempo during the final section.
tempo.zh: 指揮在最後一段提高了速度。

tempt.en: Bright advertisements can tempt shoppers to buy unnecessary items.
tempt.zh: 鮮明的廣告可能誘使消費者購買不必要的物品。

temptation.en: She resisted the temptation to check her phone while studying.
temptation.zh: 讀書時，她忍住查看手機的誘惑。

tenant.en: Each tenant received a notice about the building repairs.
tenant.zh: 每位房客都收到大樓維修通知。

tend.en: Students tend to remember ideas better when they practice regularly.
tend.zh: 學生規律練習時通常更容易記住概念。

tendency.en: The data shows a tendency toward higher attendance in spring.
tendency.zh: 資料顯示春季出席率有較高的趨勢。

tender.en: The young leaves were tender after the spring rain.
tender.zh: 春雨過後，嫩葉顯得柔軟。

tennis.en: The school tennis team practiced after class on Tuesday.
tennis.zh: 學校網球隊週二放學後練習。

tense.en: The room became tense while everyone waited for the results.
tense.zh: 大家等待結果時，房間氣氛變得緊張。

tension.en: Clear communication helped reduce tension within the group.
tension.zh: 清楚溝通有助於減少小組內的緊張氣氛。

tent.en: The campers placed their tent on level ground.
tent.zh: 露營者把帳篷搭在平坦地面上。

terminal.en: The airport terminal became crowded before the holiday weekend.
terminal.zh: 連假前，機場航廈變得很擁擠。

terrace.en: Students ate lunch on the terrace outside the library.
terrace.zh: 學生在圖書館外的露台吃午餐。

terrible.en: The weather was terrible, so the game was postponed.
terrible.zh: 天氣很糟，因此比賽延期。

terrific.en: The class did a terrific job on the science exhibition.
terrific.zh: 班上在科學展覽中表現得非常出色。

terrify.en: Loud thunder can terrify some animals during a storm.
terrify.zh: 暴風雨中的巨大雷聲可能嚇到一些動物。

territory.en: The map shows how the territory changed over several centuries.
territory.zh: 地圖顯示這片領土在數個世紀中的變化。

testify.en: The witness agreed to testify about what was observed.
testify.zh: 目擊者同意就所見情況作證。

textbook.en: The textbook includes practice questions at the end of each chapter.
textbook.zh: 課本每章最後都有練習題。

textile.en: The exhibition explains how textile production changed over time.
textile.zh: 展覽說明紡織生產如何隨時間改變。

texture.en: The artist used thick paint to create a rough texture.
texture.zh: 藝術家用厚重顏料創造粗糙質感。

thankful.en: We were thankful for the volunteers who helped after school.
thankful.zh: 我們很感謝放學後前來幫忙的志工。

theater.en: The class visited a theater to watch a student performance.
theater.zh: 班上到劇院觀看學生演出。

theft.en: The school reviewed its security policy after a reported theft.
theft.zh: 學校在接獲失竊通報後重新檢視安全政策。

theirs.en: Our project is about climate, while theirs focuses on energy.
theirs.zh: 我們的專題是氣候，他們的則著重能源。

theme.en: The main theme of the novel is friendship during change.
theme.zh: 這本小說的主要主題是在變動中的友誼。

themselves.en: The students introduced themselves before the group activity began.
themselves.zh: 小組活動開始前，學生先自我介紹。
